title: GrowWithHR EPF Wave 3C Governed Specialist-Control Retrieval Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR EPF Wave 3C controlled exemption and international-worker snapshot
sourcePack.notes: Curated source-grounded summaries for exemption governance and international-worker or SSA control reviews. Establishment-specific orders, country instruments and certificate validity require qualified legal review.

limitations: The EPF Wave 3C catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not exemption, membership, immigration, payroll or compliance advice.
Only organisation-level control statuses and evidence references are eligible for retrieval context.
Retrieval cannot determine an exemption, infer a country or person, validate a certificate, decide membership or change the deterministic decision.

chunks.title: Central exemption and savings framework
chunks.text: The controlled Code source supplies central exemption and savings context. Wave 3C reviews only whether an organisation has recorded an applicability route, current source scope and governance controls; it does not determine that an establishment is exempt.

chunks.title: Scheme exemption and continuing-membership context
chunks.text: The controlled EPF Scheme source provides scheme-level exemption, trust and continuing-membership context. An order reference is treated only as an evidence reference; retrieval never decides the legal scope or currency of an exemption.

chunks.title: EPFO exemption grant, surrender and cancellation controls
chunks.sectionReference: Exemption Manual and SOP set, 4 December 2023
chunks.text: The official EPFO exemption manual and SOP set provides operational context for grant, surrender and cancellation processes. Wave 3C does not ingest order bodies, establishment names, trust member data or investment records.

chunks.title: EPFO exemption management, returns and inspection controls
chunks.sectionReference: Management and Regulation of EPF Exemption SOP, 29 November 2023
chunks.text: The official management SOP supplies trust-governance, returns, inspection and monitoring context. The deterministic route records control statuses and evidence references only and cannot certify trust performance or compliance.

chunks.title: International-worker and excluded-employee scheme context
chunks.text: The controlled EPF Scheme source provides international-worker, excluded-employee and membership context. Wave 3C reviews organisation routing controls only and does not determine an individual's status or certificate validity.

chunks.title: EPFO international-worker and SSA guidance
chunks.text: The official EPFO FAQ describes international-worker, detachment, certificate-of-coverage and SSA concepts. It is used as controlled guidance only; country-specific instruments and current certificate evidence remain subject to qualified review.

chunks.title: Operating SSA and country-specific agreement register
chunks.sectionReference: EPFO operating SSA country pages and linked instruments
chunks.text: The EPFO operating SSA register routes reviewers to country-specific agreements, administrative arrangements and certificate forms. The product does not infer a country, detachment period, certificate validity or exclusion from this register.

chunks.title: Commencement context
chunks.text: The controlled commencement notification remains attached as effective-date context. Exemption savings and international-worker transition questions cannot be resolved by retrieval or provider output.

chunks.title: Corrigendum context
chunks.text: The controlled corrigendum remains attached so the commencement source is not represented in isolation. Its effect on exemption or international-worker routes remains subject to specialist review.
